In other words I was what is called a distinguished graduate, and, as such, I took to school teaching as the only trade I could find that need neither experience nor intellect.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Some people do not want just to ferry to the Moon, but to hop like a grasshopper to more distant Mars. I envision that the increasing power of AI engines would help problem-solving in these fields of space exploration and colonization. What cannot be solved by the human mind now, maybe will be solvable by machine intelligence in the future. Maybe, machine intelligence will help humanity transform itself from a turtle to a grasshopper. Only time will tell. Maybe then, Mars, the Red Planet, will no longer be just a "romantic fantasy" for human colonization. For generations, Mars has been such, as the influence of the four-armed Green Martians of "Barsoom" in the vintage tales of Edgar Rice Burroughs, which I, in childhood, read in the form of comics.

text: 有啲人唔係想淨係搭渡輪去月球，而係想好似蝗蟲噉跳去更遠嘅火星。我想像到人工智能引擎嘅越嚟越強大，將會有助於解決太空探索同殖民呢啲領域嘅問題。而家人類頭腦解決唔到嘅嘢，可能將來機器智能會解決到。可能，機器智能會幫助人類將自己由龜變成蝗蟲。淨係得時間先至會話你知。可能到時，火星，即係紅色星球，就唔會再只係人類殖民嘅「浪漫幻想」。幾代人嚟，火星一直都係噉嘅，就好似「巴蘇姆」嘅四臂綠色火星人喺埃德加 · 萊斯 · 巴羅斯嘅復古故事入面嘅影響，我細個嗰陣以漫畫嘅形式睇過。

At the Chinese temple, Pure Land Buddhism influenced me. These three kinds of Buddhism influenced my thinking.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It seems that Elon Musk is wondering why the Japanese are not firing rockets into space as crazily, and as frequently, as his SpaceX. My guess is that the Japanese are waiting for better technology, waiting until there is a better time (maybe now is too early), waiting for lower costs, or waiting for a big war (inevitable for some) that would shake global politics and destroy the status quo. There are proponents of teleportation, as Michio Kaku, a Japanese-American physicist, futurologist, and writer. The Japanese do not have the same "now, now, now" culture as the Americans. Their "now" culture comes from the mindfulness of the present moment, Zen, unlike American. Many Japanese like also futurology, which has become a religion on its own, there. Elon Musk and others may think that safe teleportation may be a long, long time from now, if ever. In the interim period until such technology would arise, sophisticated rockets may be the only way to get to another planet. Elon Musk has been correct many times, judging from his material and financial successes. (He has admitted that maybe a self-sustaining society on Mars and a "multiplanetary" human civilization would probably arise after his own lifetime.) Americans like "brute force," but maybe it is not the Japanese way. The Japanese have a much longer view of time than do the Americans. They believe in spirits everywhere in nature (Animism) that Americans maybe do not sense.

text: 似乎 Elon Musk 好想知點解日本人唔會好似佢嘅 SpaceX 咁瘋狂同咁頻繁噉向太空發射火箭。我估日本人係等緊更好嘅科技，等緊有更好嘅時機（可能而家太早），等緊較低嘅成本，或者等緊一場會搖擺全球政治同破壞現狀嘅大戰（對某啲人嚟講係必然嘅）。有啲人係遙距移動嘅支持者，例如係日裔美國物理學家、未來學家同作家嘅加久道夫。日本人唔係同美國人一樣有「而家，而家，而家」嘅文化。佢哋嘅「而家」文化係嚟自當下嘅正念，即係禪，唔似美國人。好多日本人都鍾意未來學，呢個已經成為咗一種自己嘅宗教，喺嗰度。埃隆 · 馬斯克同其他人可能會覺得安全嘅遙距移動可能係喺而家之後好耐好耐，如果有嘅話。喺呢類技術出現之前嘅中期，精緻嘅火箭可能係唯一可以去到另一個星球嘅方法。從佢嘅物質同財務成功嚟睇，埃隆 · 馬斯克已經講咗好多次正確嘅說話。 （佢承認過，可能火星上嘅自給自足嘅社會同「多行星」嘅人類文明，可能會喺佢自己一生之後出現。）美國人鍾意「殘忍武力」，但可能唔係日本人嘅方式。日本人對時間嘅睇法長過美國人好多。佢哋相信大自然入面隨處都有嘅靈魂（動物主義），美國人可能唔會感受到。
